set.body:
Type: implementation or qualification task
Plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Assessment: docs/institutional-readiness-plan.md
Work key: O04.1
Accountable role (person unassigned): Backend engineer with institutional data steward
Pilot scope: required

Scope: Make restricted or withdrawn data unavailable through every repository-mediated path.
Work kind: engineering
Acceptance gate: O04 (bd-01M4W40KFJVWZAM6RZ8DDH4P2D)

Acceptance criteria:
1. Persist attributable quarantine/withdrawal decisions in the independently durable lifecycle history with explicit scope, reason visibility and supported reversal rules.
2. Apply lifecycle restrictions to metadata/content, searches/counts, views, exports, reports and pending operations; preserve historical scientific records without serving withdrawn bytes.
3. Require a governed decision for dependent/shared outputs instead of inferring permission from provenance; withdrawal races cannot publish or deliver prohibited data.

Verification: Current-policy and stream/publication race tests across raw, projected and derivative fixtures.
Expected evidence: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/O04.1/receipt.json
Evidence must include: exact source/artifact and configuration identity; commands or human procedure and observed outcomes; fixtures/data scope and environment; acceptance-criterion results, negative cases and limitations; reviewer/acceptance evidence when the task requires institutional input.

Starting code/evidence:
- docs/prd.md
- modules/postgres/src/main/scala/sanctity/postgres/PostgresRecovery.scala

Blocked by:
- O03.2: bd-01M4W5P9746HPMVMR0W09DPX41
- F03.3: bd-01M4W5P5MCD12DVHWQC1KFXNDP

Completion rule: satisfy every acceptance criterion with observed evidence. Failed or not-run requirements stay open. Preserve scientific identity/history and current authority; create blocking remediation work for discovered scope. Automated or simulated evidence cannot replace a required institutional or human result. No implementation is claimed by this plan.
